The key fix (the only edit I made) is in `machtzev/generator/particles.mjs` line 403:

**Changed from:**
```javascript
const cols = s.columns ? entity.schema.filter((f) => s.columns.includes(f.label)) : entity.schema;
```

**Changed to:**
```javascript
const cols = s.columns ? s.columns.map((label) => entity.schema.find((f) => f.label === label)).filter(Boolean) : entity.schema;
```

This preserves the column order from the spec instead of reordering by schema order.
